name: Bodycam Music Pack
teaser: A comprehensive music pack featuring every song (up to this point) from the new Bodycam game
description_html:
Enhance your gaming experience with my new music pack, featuring every song from the latest Bodycam video game. This mod allows you to enjoy the immersive and dynamic soundtrack of Bodycam while playing. Perfect for fans who want to bring the intense and atmospheric music of Bodycam into their SPTarkov.

Download now and elevate your gameplay with this comprehensive 27-song collection!

Works on SPtarkov & Fika as it is only a client-sided mod, this will affect you only.

Installation Instructions:

1. Download the CustomMusic pack and unzip it using an archiver or built-in Windows archiver.

2. Place the unzipped CustomMusic folder into BepInEx/plugins.
